info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Auto Insurance Quotes Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to cancel their existing auto insurance quotes efficiently. It serves as a crucial tool for consumers who wish to modify their insurance choices, ensuring that they can manage their quotes effectively. Typical users include individuals and businesses involved in purchasing auto insurance who need the flexibility to adjust their coverage options. By providing a straightforward mechanism to cancel quotes, this API enhances user control and improves the overall experience in the auto insurance market.

delete.description: This operation allows you to cancel a quote that you have previously created. Ensure that the quote is in a cancellable state before attempting to delete it.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel a previously created quote. Ensure that the correct quote ID is specified to avoid canceling the wrong quote.

200.description: The cancellation request was processed successfully.

DeleteAutoInsuranceQuotesCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for canceling quotes in the DELETE operation. It is expected to be a string representation of the quote ID or relevant information.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the cancellation operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the cancellation operation.

DeleteAutoInsuranceQuotesCancelResponse_.description: Response object for the successful cancellation of a quote operation.

createdBy.description: User or system that created the cancellation operation record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the cancellation operation record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was automated.

Audit.description: Audit information for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request.
